name: IPWhois.net API
description: One key works for all three services. Every call needs an API key; a free key (1,000 IP, 1,000 blacklist and 1,000 MAC lookups a day, 1 request per second, basic fields) is created at https://ipwhois.net/account/api. Paid plans return the full field set, allow batch calls and are metered per month: Starter 250,000 requests at 5 per second, Pro 1,500,000 at 15 per second, Business 6,000,000 at 30 per second. Prices are on https://ipwhois.net/pricing. The key goes in the X-API-Key header, in Authorization: Bearer, or in the key query parameter.
